# Intent Revenue (intentrev.net)

> Business websites and revenue systems for local service companies. Florida and nationwide.

## Summary

Intent Revenue builds professional business websites with a search-ready foundation and offers optional LeadNet Follow-Up software for texting, intake, owner replies, review-request tools, and reactivation access where operational.

## LeadNet Websites current pricing

- **Business Website monthly:** $297 setup + $197/month. Setup and first month are collected at checkout. No minimum term.
- **Business Website upfront:** $1,497.
- **Expanded Website monthly:** $497 setup + $297/month. Setup and first month are collected at checkout. No minimum term.
- **Expanded Website upfront:** $2,497.
- **Website Care:** Optional for upfront buyers only, $49/month beginning when hosting service is activated.
- **LeadNet Follow-Up:** Optional, $149/month beginning when LeadNet is activated. Standard setup is included for website customers.
- **SMS allowance:** 1,000 SMS segments per billing month, inbound and outbound combined. Additional SMS segments are $0.03 each only within an expressly approved overage budget. Default approved overage budget is $0.
- **Product page:** https://intentrev.net/leadnet
- **Start checkout:** https://intentrev.net/begin

## Key pages

- Home: https://intentrev.net
- LeadNet Websites: https://intentrev.net/leadnet

## Exclusions

This purchase flow does not include ongoing SEO management, monthly content production, ranking campaigns, ecommerce, custom applications, complex integrations, logo design, photography, unlimited revisions, or guaranteed rankings, indexing, traffic, leads, or revenue.
